rules.name: Bypass private procurement API
rules.notes: Never cache authenticated or business API responses. Keep this rule above any broad cache rule.

rules.name: Bypass realtime notification stream
rules.notes: SSE must remain a live origin connection with no buffering or cache.

rules.name: Cache hashed frontend assets
rules.notes: The Nginx origin sets immutable one-year caching for Vite hashed assets.

rules.name: Revalidate frontend entry point
rules.notes: Do not pin the SPA entry point so releases become visible promptly.

important: This is a dashboard/API reference, not a blind import file. Review expressions and plan availability in the target Cloudflare account before applying.
